messages.content: 混合顏色#FAEBD7和#00FFFF，新的顏色是什麼？

function.name: get_prophet_details
function.description: Get detailed information about a prophet in a given religion. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

religion.description: The religion that the prophet is associated with.

historical_context.description: Whether or not to include information about the historical context in which the prophet lived. Default is false.

message.content:
將兩個十六進位顏色 **#FAEBD7**（Antique White）與 **#00FFFF**（Cyan）做平均（即每個 RGB 分量相加後除以 2）：

| 分量 | #FAEBD7 | #00FFFF | 平均 |
|------|--------|--------|------|
| R    | 250 (FA) | 0 (00) | 125 (7D) |
| G    | 235 (EB) | 255 (FF) | 245 (F5) |
| B    | 215 (D7) | 255 (FF) | 235 (EB) |

得到的新顏色為 **#7DF5EB**，是一種淡淡的青綠色（light teal）。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "混合顏色#FAEBD7和#00FFFF，新的顏色是什麼？" They want to mix two colors: #FAEBD7 (AntiqueWhite) and #00FFFF (Cyan). They want the resulting color. We need to compute the average of the RGB values. #FAEBD7: hex FA=250, EB=235, D7=215. #00FFFF: 0, 255, 255. Average: (250+0)/2=125, (235+255)/2=245, (215+255)/2=235. So new color: #7D F5 EB? Wait 125 decimal is 7D hex. 245 decimal is F5 hex. 235 decimal is EB hex. So #7DF5EB. That is the average. But maybe they want mixing by blending? Usually mixing colors in digital space is averaging. So answer: #7DF5EB. Provide explanation. Also mention that it's a light teal. Provide hex code.
